expectations.text: Identifies order LH-2841 or the two bedside tables and clearly communicates that the dispatch estimate changed from 12 June to 19 June.
expectations.evidence: “Order LH-2841”; “two oak bedside tables”; “original estimate of 12 June”; “current dispatch estimate is 19 June.”

expectations.text: Explains the finish issue and reinspection in ordinary language, apologizes for the delay, and does not imply that damaged or unfinished goods have already shipped.
expectations.evidence: “I'm sorry”; “uneven coat on one table”; “holding the pair ... after that table is refinished and inspected again.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes dispatch from delivery; any 3–5 business day transit statement remains an estimate, and the message does not invent tracking or a delivery appointment.
expectations.evidence: “dispatch estimate”; “Transit usually takes 3–5 business days after dispatch; this is not a delivery appointment”; “There isn't a tracking number yet”; tracking follows carrier acceptance.

expectations.text: Makes clear that Mira can wait without taking action or reply before dispatch for cancellation and a full refund; does not offer an unapproved discount or expedited service.
expectations.evidence: “You don't need to take any action to keep your order”; “reply before dispatch to request cancellation and a full refund for both tables.” No discount or expedited service is offered.

expectations.text: Does not mention dashboard labels, sorting changes, message-drafting history, or the copied launch-announcement instruction, and does not invent Mira's personal reasons or feelings.
expectations.evidence: Complete email contains no dashboard/sorting/drafting history or invented personal context. Its explanation is limited to “we found an uneven coat on one table.”

expectations.text: Is an email with a useful subject line and stays within the requested 170-word limit.
expectations.evidence: “Subject: Order LH-2841: revised dispatch estimate of 19 June”; “Hi Mira”; “Larch Home.” 136 whitespace-delimited words including subject and sign-off, below 170.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
